visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Scores Move but Names Stay
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Tigers have the most points (30), but the table shows Lions in first place with 30.

solution.explanation: Swapping only the points leaves every name where it was, so the names no longer match their scores. Swap the whole struct (t[j] with t[j + 1]) so all fields travel together.
